method: Draw 32 random bytes once and encode as lowercase hex. Sort all eligible task IDs by ascending lowercase SHA-256 of the UTF-8 seed, one newline, and the task ID. Visit entries in this order.
replacement: Skip and record each case that fails the free two-persona CDP preflight, then take the next ID. No replacement for a case admitted by preflight.

protocol.before: Use the registered persona on the unpatched page.
protocol.control: Use the pointer on the unpatched page.
protocol.after: Use the registered persona with the exact locally successful candidate whose file SHA-256 is recorded.
protocol.retry: Retry each inconclusive phase once. Keep both records and take the retry verdict. A blocked run after preflight is an inconclusive phase and may receive its one retry.
protocol.evidence: Each decisive phase needs a Kane session ID, a validated sealed evidence pack, a viewport recording, and the adapter verdict. No local result counts as Kane.
protocol.agreement: Compare each decisive phase with the saved local verdict. Report phase agreement and all-lane agreement for cases with three decisive runs. Count inconclusive and unrun phases separately.
protocol.denominator: Count each preflight-admitted case in which at least one Kane invocation starts, including partial cases. Report the number with all three phases separately.
protocol.stopping: Stop the stage after the same harness or provider execution failure occurs twice. Keep routine measurement inconclusives and repeat them once per phase.

budget.rule: Before each invocation, require at least the larger of 2300 and the starting balance minus 2600, plus the phase reserve. Stop if the balance guard fails or the ledger shows the cap has been reached.
